full_page.content:
1937, September
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 211 Cont.
Sep. 15th Louis Yelinck - 26 - blind since about 2 weeks old - prays, hopes gets discouraged, etc.
Josephine Banchard - 68 - big goitre-aftaid of operation
Mrs. Mable Hagmeyer - about 35 - "Chr. Scientist" - parted from Husband since last Nov .... asks prayers.
Rose Miulski - 54 - arthritis - was prepared for death, given up as hopeless; Enrolled in Ser. Mass A. July - coming OK ... Deo Gr.
Catherine Bohl - 59 - cancer of breast - hopeless according to Drs. coming back now in fearful pain since June, has not been out of Pain.
Page 212 Sep. 15 Mrs. Nora Fisher - 53 - of New Brunswick - non Cath. - high blood- pressure and nerves.
Sister Mr. Anita - nerveous.
Mr. John Holmes - Eloise
Mrs. Mary Price + Sunday - 55 - was thought to be dying ten yrs ago. Her Sister a Dominican Nun - offered herself to die in her place be- cause of her eight children - Now youngest is 19 said her 15 decades of the rosary to die before her nun sister. She is to be buried To- morrow - in Our Lady of Sorrows - 9 o'cl.
Bacaueline Mielke - 4 - nerveous - was very sick at about 7 months has not learned to speak.
House (or flat) of 5 or 6 rooms wanted - 3102 Canton Ave.
Mrs. Pohl - 66 - gall-ston-trouble. Drs. afraid to operate on ac- count of blood condition.
Dorothy Collyer -- % Fr. Venantius. ... Shorthand & Typist Shirley Genev. Filochowski - 22 - cripled hand - fears operation.
Page 213 Sep. Anna Szydlaski - 57 - thought to be dying Dr. give her not more than a few hours. Daughter promises to read "Conception" if mother is spared.
Fr. Helten - scrupulos - St. Jos. Mercy
